Nintendo Argues Switch 2 Customers Are 'Not Entitled' to Tariff Refunds - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
A lawsuit aims to force Nintendo to share its tariff refunds to customers who bought a Switch 2. The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled some of President Trump's tariffs illegal, which means the extra fees Nintendo paid to ship the Switch 2 and other hardware to the U.S. could be returned. But Nintendo isn't required to pass those refunds on to customers. In other news, the highly-anticipated The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past DLC will get its debut next month during gamescom Opening Night Live.
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

text:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Official Final Trailer (2026) Tom Holland, Zendaya, Jon Bernthal
Take a look at the Final Trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day, the latest installment in the Marvel Cinematic Universe distributed by Marvel Studios. Walk down memory lane throughout Peter Parker's journey from his humble beginnings in Spider-Man: Homecoming, leading into the trials and tribulations of Spider-Man: Far From Home, and the calamity of consequences from Spider-Man: No Way Home. Spider-Man: Brand New Day is in theaters on July 31.


It's been four years since Peter Parker (Tom Holland) made the ultimate sacrifice to save the multiverse, and the world has forgotten who he is. His friends Ned Lees (Jacob Batalon) and MJ (Zendaya) have moved on with life, and Peter has fallen into being a full-time Spider-Man. Being New York's full-time super-hero protector has Peter rubbing shoulders with Frank Castle (Jon Bernthal) and battling Scorpion (Michael Mando), but with the arrival of a new threat, and Peter's powers evolving, things will never be the same again.  


Spider-Man: Brand New Day stars Tom Holland, Zendaya, Jon Bernthal, Mark Ruffalo, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, and Michael Mando. The film is directed by Destin Daniel Cretton and written by Chris McKenna, Erik Sommers, and Stan Lee.


Spider-Man: Brand New Day arrives in theaters July 31st.

Makinarium Limited-Edition Terminator T-800 Optics Official Trailer
MAKINARIUM studio edition is proud to announce its first collectible, the T 800 Optics. This exclusive piece is officially licensed from the iconic 1984 hit movie THE TERMINATOR & its blockbuster sequel TERMINATOR 2 JUDGMENT DAY, with this year being TERMINATOR 2 JUDGMENT DAY’S 35th Anniversary. 

The T-800 Optics features premium materials, a beautifully crafted display cradle, exceptional high-quality packaging and an owner authentication display. 

Every T-800 Optics is embedded with a secure encrypted NFC chip, powered by Fan Connect. Simply tap your collectible with a smartphone to unlock a dedicated digital portal, unique to your individual piece. Through this portal, owners can verify the authenticity and provenance of their collectible with a digital certificate of ownership linked to its unique serial number. 

Every item is made for collectors, by filmmakers. You can own this piece of cinematic history with ‘T-800 units’ shipping very shortly, and pre-orders available right now.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker: Exclusive Quest Gameplay - IGN First
Our The Blood of Dawnwalker IGN First series continues with another exclusive gameplay video, and this time we’re showcasing an entire quest from start to finish: Pearly and Precious. It’s a relatively short adventure, but one that introduces a brand new creature: a sanzhana, or “pixie”. 

The video shows this quest being played during the day, which means protagonist Coen has access to his witchcraft rather than vampiric skills. You’ll get to see some magic in action, including the speed-enhancing spell and the offensive Ravenous Flock curse, which causes an eruption of spectral birds that damage all nearby foes. There’s also plenty of sword-on-sword duelling, as well as some poking around in the pockets (and mouths) of corpses. 

While this is just a short errand, it sets up one of The Blood of Dawnwalker’s most interesting ideas. The fluttering little pixie encountered in this quest has something of great value to offer – we’ll reveal more about this powerful reward later this week.

#IGN #TheBloodOfDawnwalker #RPG
